cases.name: Manager can assign Sales while Supermarket stays in its own Portal and cannot read CRM customer workspace
Sales creates an owned pending customer through actual form without a password field or sensitive URL parameters
A different Sales cannot read the new customer through API
Own referral link and authenticated local QR render without third party QR requests
Invalid public referral stops safely; a valid link registers one synthetic pending customer without exposing passwords
Admin reassigns with a reason in actual form; previous Sales loses access and new Sales gains it
Historical order retains Sales attribution, HN sees its order, HCM is denied and waiting-quote warehouse cannot prepare or issue
Warehouse spreadsheet board has status tabs and warehouse/date filters, with no document overflow at 375/768/1440
Actual Sales quote and customer revision form return the order to waiting quote without permitting shipment
Hydrated referral controls activate/deactivate own code and navigate the current-owned own-referral filter
Scoped notification hub and Accountant payment/bank navigation work while restricted finance controls remain hidden
Lost payment response reuses the same uploaded proof and idempotency key, returning one native receipt

screenshotData: Synthetic QA identities only; no passwords or activation tokens captured
